# Sun of a Beach – Hospitality & Corporate

> Sun of a Beach is a Greek brand that designs premium beach towels, pool towels, bathrobes, welcome gifts and beach accessories. This site covers its B2B work: custom and branded products for hotels, resorts, villas, yachts and beach clubs, corporate gifts, and event gifts. Clients include Four Seasons Astir Palace Athens, One&Only, W Hotels and The Romanos Costa Navarino. Contact: business@sunofabeach.com, +30 210 7231646, Karneadou 25, Athens, Greece.

## Main pages
- [Hospitality](https://b2b.sunofabeach.com/hospitality/): pool and beach towels, bath towels, bathrobes, welcome gifts and hotel boutique products for hotels, villas, yachts and beach clubs
- [Hospitality welcome gifts](https://b2b.sunofabeach.com/hospitality-welcome-gifts/): curated welcome gifts for hotel guests
- [Corporate gifts](https://b2b.sunofabeach.com/corporate-gifts/): branded gifts for clients, employees and corporate events
- [Events](https://b2b.sunofabeach.com/events/): gifts for weddings, christenings, social and corporate events
- [Projects](https://b2b.sunofabeach.com/projects/): case studies with hotels and resorts in Greece and abroad
- [About](https://b2b.sunofabeach.com/about/): the company, its approach and sustainability

## Selected projects
- [Four Seasons Astir Palace Hotel Athens](https://b2b.sunofabeach.com/project/four-seasons-astir-palace-hotel-athens/): linen kimonos and towels
- [One&Only Le Saint Géran, Mauritius](https://b2b.sunofabeach.com/project/oneonly-le-saint-geran/): welcome gift towels
- [BOND Beach Club at One&Only Kéa](https://b2b.sunofabeach.com/project/oneonly-kea-bond-beach-club/): beach towels
- [The Romanos, Costa Navarino](https://b2b.sunofabeach.com/project/the-romanos-costa-navarino/): boutique products and welcome gifts
- [The Rooster, Antiparos](https://b2b.sunofabeach.com/project/the-rooster/): in-room, pool and beach towels
- [Gift yacht](https://b2b.sunofabeach.com/project/gift-yacht/): yacht pool towels
